SELECT 
  s.format,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.quantity), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-05-26' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS sale_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS return_lines,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key

SELECT 
  s.format,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.quantity), 0), 2) AS return_rate
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key

calls.statement:
-- Check for data quality issues (negative quantities)
SELECT 
  'Sales negative qty' AS issue_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-05-26' AND sale_date <= '2025-06-22'
  AND quantity < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Returns negative qty' AS issue_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date >= '2025-05-26' AND return_date <= '2025-06-22'
  AND quantity_returned < 0
